column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3994): the test deploys through the real store factory on each dialect, and gets each database from testutil.TestDB, so the mysql and mssql arms skip in this PostgreSQL-only job (CLEAT_TEST_DB) while the postgres arm RUNS -- two skips, not three. Measured by name, not by delta: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES=<pg> go test ./cmd/cleatctl/ -run 'TestDeployWorkflowAndVersionsOnEveryDialect' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these two, and 0 failures. The test FAILS rather than skips when a dialect's DSN is set and unreachable (testutil.TestDB), so the skip can only mean "this job supplies no database of that dialect". With CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL set, both arms run and pass.
